Table 6.2: Multi-Class Attack Detection Breakdown on CICIDS2018 (N = 100,670)

Table 6.2: Illustrates the granular category-level breakdown for the CICIDS2018 test split. The system demonstrates near-flawless performance on volumetric and automated authentication vectors. For SSH-Bruteforce attacks, the pipeline identifies 14,067 out of 14,106 attack instances, achieving 99.72% recall. This heightened sensitivity stems from the distinctive temporal signatures of automated password guessing, including rapid packet inter-arrival times (IATs), uniform packet lengths, and abnormal TCP flag combinations that clash sharply with the learned manifold of legitimate communication. Similarly, all 8 test flows of FTP-BruteForce are detected (100.00% recall), confirming that extreme class rarity in training data does not preclude reliable isolation when non-linear autoencoder gating is employed. Concurrently, 77,877 legitimate benign flows are cleared at Stage-1, yielding an exceptional Benign class precision of 99.95%.
